title: The Link Between Anemia and Deficits in Memory and Attention in Individuals With Sickle Cell Disease
brief_summary: Sickle cell disease is an inherited blood disorder that affects red blood cells (RBCs). People with sickle cell disease frequently experience anemia, or a low number of RBCs. RBCs are responsible for carrying oxygen to the brain and other body tissues that need oxygen to function properly. The purpose of this study is to determine what changes, which were possibly caused by anemia, exist in the brains of individuals with sickle cell disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of sickle cell disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Claustrophobia
* Mass lesion (e.g., meningioma, cyst, or spinal block)
* Need for life support constant monitoring
* Any unstable condition that is likely to require resuscitation
* Presence of a pacemaker or other iron-containing magnetic substances in the body
